sql:
SELECT
  to_char(o.closed_at, 'YYYY-MM') AS month,
  count(*) AS opportunities_closed,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE o.is_won) AS closed_won,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT o.is_won) AS closed_lost,
  round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE o.is_won) / NULLIF(count(*), 0), 1) AS win_rate_pct,
  round(avg(DATE_PART('day', o.closed_at - o.created_at))::numeric, 1) AS avg_cycle_days,
  round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY DATE_PART('day', o.closed_at - o.created_at))::numeric, 1) AS median_cycle_days
FROM opportunities o
JOIN accounts a ON a.id = o.account_id
JOIN tenants t ON t.id = a.tenant_id
WHERE (t.industry ILIKE '%industrial%' OR t.industry ILIKE '%office equipment%' OR t.industry ILIKE '%wholesal%')
  AND o.is_closed = true
  AND o.closed_at IS NOT NULL
  AND o.closed_at >= DATE '2023-01-01'
  AND o.closed_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY to_char(o.closed_at, 'YYYY-MM')
ORDER BY month ASC
